items.name: Exponential Moving Average
items.summary: Average price that weights recent bars more, with older bars fading exponentially.

items.name: Linear Regression Curve
items.summary: End point of a rolling least-squares line fit, drawn on price and colored by its slope.

items.name: Moving Average
items.summary: Price average of a chosen type, such as SMA, EMA, or HMA, with an optional second line.

items.name: Simple Moving Average
items.summary: Average price of the last N bars, with every bar weighted equally.

items.name: Smoothed Moving Average
items.summary: Wilder's recursive average of price, slower than an EMA of equal length, colored by slope.

items.name: TRAMA
items.summary: Average that speeds up while new highs or lows keep forming and flattens when they stop.

items.name: Variable Index Dynamic Average
items.summary: EMA whose speed adapts bar by bar to momentum or volatility, colored by trend regime.

items.name: Zero-Lag Exponential Moving Average
items.summary: EMA of price adjusted to offset its lag, so it turns sooner, colored by slope.

items.name: Bollinger Bands
items.summary: Simple moving average with bands a set number of standard deviations above and below.

items.name: Bollinger Bands %B
items.summary: Price position within the bands: 1 at the upper band, 0.5 at the basis, 0 at the lower.

items.name: Donchian Channels
items.summary: Highest high and lowest low over the lookback, with a midline between them.

items.name: Keltner Channels
items.summary: EMA with bands set a multiple of average true range above and below it.

items.name: Moving Average Envelope
items.summary: Bands a fixed percentage above and below a basis average of a chosen type.

items.name: Predictive Ranges
items.summary: Stepped average with 2 upper and 2 lower range levels spaced from it by an ATR multiple.

items.name: Chande Kroll Stop
items.summary: Long and short stop lines from ATR-adjusted highs and lows over 2 lookbacks.

items.name: Chandelier Exit
items.summary: Long stop below the highest high and short stop above the lowest low, offset by ATR.

items.name: Parabolic SAR
items.summary: Trailing stop marks that speed up toward price as the trend makes new extremes.

items.name: SuperTrend
items.summary: ATR-based trailing line that flips above or below price when price closes through it.

items.name: Williams Alligator
items.summary: Jaw, teeth, and lips lines: smoothed averages of median price, each shifted forward.

items.name: Awesome Oscillator
items.summary: Fast 5-bar minus slow 34-bar simple average of median price, as a histogram.

items.name: Balance of Power
items.summary: Close minus open divided by the bar's high-low range, from -1 to +1.

items.name: Chande Momentum Oscillator
items.summary: Net up versus down moves over their total, from -100 to +100, with +50 and -50 levels.

items.name: Commodity Channel Index
items.summary: Distance of price from its average, scaled by mean deviation, with +100 and -100 levels.

items.name: Connors RSI
items.summary: Average of a short RSI, a streak RSI, and the percent rank of the 1-bar change, 0 to 100.

items.name: Coppock Curve
items.summary: Weighted average of the sum of a long and a short rate of change.

items.name: Detrended Price Oscillator
items.summary: Price minus a moving average shifted by about half its length, removing longer trends.

items.name: Elder Ray
items.summary: Bull power (high minus EMA) and bear power (low minus EMA) as histograms.

items.name: Fisher Transform
items.summary: Recent-range position of median price, transformed to sharpen turns, with a trigger line.

items.name: Know Sure Thing
items.summary: Weighted sum of 4 smoothed rates of change over different lookbacks, with a signal line.

items.name: MACD
items.summary: Difference between fast and slow EMAs, with a signal line and a histogram of their gap.

items.name: Percentage Price Oscillator
items.summary: Fast minus slow average as a percent of the slow one, with a signal line and histogram.

items.name: Rate of Change
items.summary: Percent change in price over the lookback, or the raw difference in Momentum mode.

items.name: Relative Strength Index
items.summary: Wilder-smoothed gains versus losses on a 0 to 100 scale, with 70, 50, and 30 levels.

items.name: Relative Vigor Index
items.summary: Close minus open relative to the bar range, smoothed and summed, with a signal line.

items.name: Schaff Trend Cycle
items.summary: Double stochastic of MACD on a 0 to 100 scale, with 75 and 25 trigger lines.

items.name: SMI Ergodic Oscillator
items.summary: Double-smoothed momentum ratio with a signal line, or their difference as a histogram.

items.name: Stochastic
items.summary: Smoothed close position within the recent high-low range as %K, with a %D signal line.

items.name: Stochastic RSI
items.summary: Where RSI sits within its own recent high-low range, as smoothed %K and %D lines.

items.name: TRIX
items.summary: 1-bar percent change of a triple-smoothed EMA of the close, with a signal line.

items.name: True Strength Index
items.summary: Double-smoothed price change over double-smoothed absolute change, with a signal line.

items.name: Ultimate Oscillator
items.summary: Buying pressure averaged over 3 lookbacks and weighted toward the shortest, 0 to 100.

items.name: Williams %R
items.summary: Price position within the recent high-low range, on a 0 to -100 scale.

items.name: Aroon
items.summary: How recently the lookback's high and low occurred, as up and down lines from 0 to 100.

items.name: Average Directional Index
items.summary: Trend strength from 0 to 100 with +DI and -DI direction lines and a key level at 25.

items.name: Choppiness Index
items.summary: Summed true range versus the net high-low range, 0 to 100, with 61.8 and 38.2 bands.

items.name: Gator Oscillator
items.summary: Alligator line spreads: jaw to teeth above zero, teeth to lips below zero, as histograms.

items.name: Vortex Indicator
items.summary: Upward and downward trend movement relative to true range, as VI+ and VI- lines.

items.name: Average True Range
items.summary: Typical bar size, including gaps from the prior close, smoothed over the lookback.

items.name: Bollinger Bands Width
items.summary: Band gap divided by the middle band, with lines at its recent lowest and highest values.

items.name: Chaikin Volatility
items.summary: Percent change in the smoothed high-low range compared with a set number of bars ago.

items.name: Historical Volatility
items.summary: Standard deviation of bar-to-bar log returns, scaled to an annual percentage.

items.name: Mass Index
items.summary: Summed ratio of smoothed to double-smoothed high-low range, with 27 and 26.5 levels.

items.name: Relative Volatility Index
items.summary: Smoothed standard deviation on up closes versus down closes, scaled 0 to 100.

items.name: Squeeze Index
items.summary: Compression score from 0 to 100 based on converging price envelopes, with a level at 80.

items.name: Standard Deviation
items.summary: Root-mean-square distance of price from its average over the lookback.

items.name: TTM Squeeze
items.summary: Momentum histogram with dots marking when Bollinger Bands are inside Keltner Channels.

items.name: Ulcer Index
items.summary: Root-mean-square of percentage drawdowns from the running high in the lookback window.

items.name: Accumulation / Distribution
items.summary: Running total of volume weighted by where each bar closes within its range.

items.name: Chaikin Money Flow
items.summary: Volume-weighted average of where bars close within their ranges, from -1 to +1.

items.name: Chaikin Oscillator
items.summary: Fast EMA minus slow EMA of the accumulation/distribution line.

items.name: Ease of Movement
items.summary: Midpoint change times range per unit of volume, smoothed, showing how freely price moves.

items.name: Force Index
items.summary: Price change times volume, smoothed with an EMA.

items.name: Intraday Intensity
items.summary: Volume weighted by where each bar closes in its range, as a normalized oscillator.

items.name: Klinger Oscillator
items.summary: Difference between fast and slow EMAs of signed volume force, with a signal line.

items.name: Money Flow Index
items.summary: Volume-weighted RSI of typical price, from 0 to 100, with 80 and 20 levels.

items.name: Negative Volume Index
items.summary: Cumulative line that changes only on bars with lower volume than the prior bar.

items.name: On Balance Volume
items.summary: Running total of volume, added on up closes and subtracted on down closes.

items.name: Percentage Volume Oscillator
items.summary: Fast minus slow EMA of volume as a percent of the slow one, with signal and histogram.

items.name: Positive Volume Index
items.summary: Cumulative line that changes only on bars with higher volume than the prior bar.

items.name: Price Volume Trend
items.summary: Running total of volume multiplied by each bar's percent price change.

items.name: Volume
items.summary: Amount traded per bar as columns along the bottom of the price pane, colored by direction.

items.name: Volume Flow Indicator
items.summary: Sum of capped volume signed by significant price moves, scaled by average volume.

items.name: Volume Oscillator
items.summary: Percent difference between a fast and a slow EMA of volume.

items.name: 52 Week High/Low
items.summary: Highest high and lowest low over a rolling window of weeks, as step lines.

items.name: Pivot Points Standard
items.summary: Pivot, support, and resistance levels from the prior period's high, low, and close.

items.name: Volume Weighted Average Price
items.summary: Running average of price weighted by volume from the session or period start, with bands.

items.name: Williams Fractal
items.summary: Markers above swing highs and below swing lows that stand out from the bars on each side.

items.name: ZigZag
items.summary: Lines connecting swing highs and lows that reverse by at least a set percentage.

items.name: Correlation Coefficient
items.summary: Rolling Pearson correlation between this symbol and a comparison symbol, from -1 to +1.

items.name: Journal trades
items.summary: Basic indicator

items.name: Bar Stats
items.summary: Table of per-bar volume, delta, buy and sell volume, and optional trade counts.

items.name: Cumulative Trade Count Delta
items.summary: Running total of buy trades minus sell trades, restarting at each chosen period.

items.name: Cumulative Volume Delta
items.summary: Running total of buy volume minus sell volume, restarting at each chosen period.

items.name: Trade Count
items.summary: Number of executed trades in each bar, as a histogram.

items.name: Trade Count Delta
items.summary: Number of buy trades minus sell trades in each bar, as a histogram.

items.name: Volume Delta
items.summary: Aggressive buy volume minus sell volume in each bar, as a histogram.

items.name: Rolling Volume Profile
items.summary: Buy and sell volume by price over the latest bars, with point of control and value area.

items.name: Session Volume Profile
items.summary: Buy and sell volume at each price for every session, with point of control and value area.

items.name: Time Price Opportunity
items.summary: Market profile per session, with a letter for each time block that traded at each price.

items.name: Visible Range Volume Profile
items.summary: Volume by price for the visible bars, split by up and down bars, at the right edge.

items.name: Fixed Range Volume Tails
items.summary: Supply and demand zones at a chosen range's top and bottom, from sell and buy volume.

items.name: Rolling Volume Tails
items.summary: Supply and demand zones at the latest bars' top and bottom, from sell and buy volume.

items.name: Session Volume Tails
items.summary: Supply and demand zones at each session's top and bottom, from sell and buy volume.

items.name: Visible Range Volume Tails
items.summary: Supply and demand zones at the visible range's top and bottom, from sell and buy volume.

items.name: Footprint
items.summary: Sell and buy volume at each price inside every bar, shown beside or within the bars.

items.name: Visible Range Footprint
items.summary: Sell and buy volume by price across visible bars, as a single column at the chart edge.

items.name: Volume Bubbles
items.summary: Circles at the prices in each bar where the most volume traded, sized by volume.
